probes.text: Daenerys, her people starving and thirsty in a red wasteland, sends three riders out in different directions to scout.
Tyrion turns up in King's Landing to take his seat as acting Hand, which delights Cersei not at all.
Beyond the Wall, the Night's Watch takes shelter in the cramped keep of a man surrounded by his many daughter-wives.
Theon steps off a boat onto rain-lashed Pyke after nine years away, and his father sneers at his fine Northern clothes.
Sam takes an interest in one of Craster's pregnant wives and begs Jon to help her; Jon wants nothing to do with it.
On a Dragonstone beach, Stannis's smuggler-turned-knight haggles with a boastful pirate captain to bring his fleet over.

3.title: What Is Dead May Never Die

probes.text: Catelyn rides into Renly's sprawling camp of tents and banners, come to talk terms on Robb's behalf.
At Renly's camp, two armored fighters batter each other in a practice duel while onlookers watch from the grass.
Catelyn sits mounted in an open field while the two Baratheon brothers ride out to parley with each other.
Littlefinger turns up unannounced at Catelyn's tent in Renly's camp, all courtesy and old familiarity.
The Night's Watch makes camp at an ancient ringfort on a hilltop beyond the Wall, the Fist of the First Men.
Jeor Mormont hands Jon over to a veteran ranger leading a small party up into the Frostfang mountains.
Jorah argues that Daenerys should win the support of the common people of Westeros rather than buy an army.

6.title: The Old Gods and the New

probes.text: In the aftermath of another battle, Robb walks the field and falls into conversation again with the healer Talisa.
In Qarth, Daenerys keeps pressing for a ship to carry an army west while holding Xaro's attentions at arm's length.
At Harrenhal, Arya lingers over Tywin's table pouring wine while the Lannister commanders pore over their maps.
Cersei sits with Sansa and tells her the only people worth loving are one's own children.
Jon marches his wildling prisoner across the snow, and she taunts him every step of the way.
Joffrey berates Varys for knowing so little about where the Stark armies actually are.

fine_only.text: Yara turns up at Winterfell and mocks her brother for seizing a castle he has no men to hold.
Jorah agrees to go with Daenerys into the House of the Undying rather than let her enter alone.

probes.text: Sansa, standing beside Joffrey before the fighting starts, urges him to ride out and lead his men himself.

fine_only.text: Tyrion, out in the streets beyond the gate, fights on foot among the Gold Cloaks.

probes.text: Melisandre stands with Stannis over the flames, telling him what glory she can see waiting there for him.
